works.body:
者委任具ハチナナ 様

GODARCAの自探索者をお願い致します。
斧をぶん回して暴れ散らかしていただければと思います。
ハチナナさんの描くコイツがずっと見たいと思っていました。誕生日にかこつけて駆け込みます。

構図等お任せします
SNSにてアイコンの使用や掲載（名前記載）する予定です


※資料の添付が抜けていたため再送させていただきます。
よろしくお願い致します……！

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1-40GzBxhAwRxoFk2loZPKt0uMEBJJnwT

Hello! Your paintings are so beautiful! Please draw me and my friends!
❤︎ Characters
Kiu: Kiu should be drawn with the visor of his jacket removed. If it is easier to draw him without his jacket, please take it off. Please draw Kiu's pose and facial expression as if Kiu is excited and happy.
Kyoko: Please draw her pose and facial expression as if she is drinking coffee with both hands.
Mitch: Please draw him in the clothes you refer to.
Have the boys (Mitch, Mule and Pangin) play a card game or something. Please draw them looking like they are having fun.
❤︎ Height 
Mule will be the tallest, Kiu the second tallest, Mitch the third tallest, Kyouko the fourth tallest, and Pan G will be the smallest since he is a stuffed penguin.
❤︎ Composition
Any background is acceptable!
If possible, please provide a PSD file and separate the characters from the background.

https://imgur.com/a/3A4GQPh

Hello again ハチナナ先生! I'd like to request my OC! 

Her name is Philippa, but I like to call her Pepsi. 
She's an outgoing woman that likes to have fun! She likes action, pranking her friends, and playfully flirt with people. 

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1zG8hlw3JNPJ94Z5Ex8CfSWZfRUDGlCv0?usp=sharing 

I'm ok with any composition as long as she looks like she's having fun! Maybe posing handsomely in front of a mirror? Or grinning cheekily at the viewer (us). Feel free to decide! thank you so much!

I apologize for the lack of references! I thought I had added them all and not just sent you a sing picture. I am so sorry!

There are two characters "Manni" and "ian". "Manni" is the one with black hair, and tired eyes. He is 204 centimeters tall . I would like "Manni" to be holding "Ian's" face to examine it closely. I want "Manni" to look a little curious and intrigued while he is looking at "Ian". "Manni's" personality is direct, quiet, mysterious.
"Ian" is the character with brown hair and he is 180 centimeters tall. I want "Ian" to be a little embarrassed that a handsome guy is staring at him, so Ian does not look directly at "Manni". I would like "Ian's" to seem like he is uncomfortable with the situation. "Ian's" personality is kind, but bashful. However I would still like the image to seem rather cute.

The scene should be in a foggy mysterious forest. The time this takes place is medieval.

The art needs to be in a 16:9 ratio.

thank you so much

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1jlZt53O12oH-wHlg_8O0NCnHfAGPYtND?usp=drive_link

Sensei, thank you very much again for your last request! 
We would like to request another original character couple!

✨️Jonas
26 // male // 190cm
- he acts stoic and barely shows emotions, but he cares greatly for other people. Most of the time, he looks a bit sad, but he smiles more when he's with Nans.

✨️ Nans
- 26 // male // 180cm
- He's harmless at first glance, but can become sly when situation demands for it; he has a tendency to overreact or be dramatic to purposely irritate people outside of business interactions.

✨️Request
We'd like to request an artwork similar to our last request!

They are also a couple and their relationship can be both affectionate and full of teases towards each other! Feel free to draw them together in any way you'd like!
Please feel free to choose the composition and pose freely!

✨️References
https://sta.sh/211jl1bq3lja?edit=1 
https://toyhou.se/21373543.jonas?key=RtAzLepOZgtAOr1

Thank you very much for your consideration!

ハチナナ先生はじめまして、KAMINAと申します。台湾人です。
いつもツイッターで先生の素敵なイラストを見ていました。
skebでの依頼が再開しましたとお聞きして、この機会ぜひ依頼をできれば幸いです。

【依頼内容】
私の 2 人の OC を一緒の絵を描いていただけるとよろしいでしょうか？
キャラ参照は下記のURLをご覧ください。
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/110rYoNnXZBWpV7SjtV6q0ugLyDYuQQiy?usp=sharing
空にとってシモンは守るべき存在だった。
シモンは強い好奇心と無謀さから度々すこし危ないな状況に陥っていました。
一緒にいる、助け合い、目が離せない。
こんな二人の仲睦まじい感じを描いて頂けたら嬉しいです。(二人はまだ恋人未満の関係)
【テーマ】
服装、構図、ポーズなど自由に描いてください！
できれば二人で軽くカジュアルな服を着て街に買い物に行ったり、
肉まんを食べたりしましょうがいいです（＾ω＾）

【使用用途】
自分用の壁紙とアイコン、個人用な印刷などの使用
他の方への依頼の際に資料として使用させていただくことがあります。
SNS、ネットで公開する時には、先生を注記してから投稿します。
できれば人物の透過やサインなどは別レイヤーに分けていただけると助かります。

ここまでお読み、私のリクエストを考慮していただければ幸いです、本当にありがとうございます。

If you accept secondary creation, please consider the following: Cid Raines from Final Fantasy XIII with a sheep (or a plush version of the sheep) from the same game? 
The man's expression should be serious. The sheep's expression should be happy ":3" ":D" as contrast.
Do what you want with everything else.
Apologies for machine translation.

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1E90-l3nsYvdrWpsXi-XzbQMK0HmLh-CV
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/14MIy6-ro4mbwS7VvUDBc7hDS606yJyqm

Please appeal if price is the only complaint!

「CP MEMO」の中から好きなシチュエーションで描いてください。 ☺️💞
でも、他にアイディアがあればそれでもいいです!！ アレンちゃんとフレくんを好きなように描いてください。✨   ポーズや構図はお任せします。 
前作のような明るい色のイラストだとうれしいです
服の選択肢も豊富なので、描きたいものや修正したいものを自由に選んでください。
 SDの絵がとても可愛かったので、また入れてもらえると嬉しいのですが...！(でも、描く気にならなくても大丈夫です。

このリクエストを検討してくれて、どうもありがとうございました! 💛💙

Hello! I really like your artwork!

I would like you to draw my OC!

He is a short-ish young adult with bright blonde hair and bright blue eyes. He is very mischievous and looks pleased with himself all the time. 
He wears a banana yellow suit vest with same coloured bowtie over a white shirt. He also wears suit trousers of the same colour. He also wears an empty butter container on his head like a helmet.

I have no pose or expression in mind so you can choose yourself, just make sure it shows him being mischievous!

Thank you very much, and I apologise for the lack of references, I've never had him drawn before!

If it's alright with you, I would like to commission an OC couple with my friend's OC and mine.

✨️ Asher (black haired guy with purple eyes) 
-24, male, 177cm
-his personality is similar to an excited puppy, always cheerful, friendly and happy. 
-Please keep his skin close to the original (please do not draw him with very light skin). He has a heart shaped double ahoge.

✨️ Yuwun (dark haired guy with yellow eyes)
-26, male, 186cm 
-his personality is similar to a sly cat, mysterious and detached but has a lot of charisma. 
-please do not forget his two moles under his eye.

✨️ Request:
Please feel free to choose the composition and pose freely!
Since they're dating, I would be very happy to receive a piece with a cute interaction!
If it's alright with you, I'd also like to have SD of these two on my artwork!

Thank you for your consideration!
